name: Constitutional Dyserythropoietic Anemia

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Constitutional Dyserythropoietic Anemia

criteria.description: Presence of characteristic dyserythropoiesis with multinucleated erythroblasts in bone marrow biopsy
Chronic hemolytic anemia with ineffective erythropoiesis and reticulocytopenia
Identification of pathogenic mutations in genes associated with CDA (e.g., CDAN1, SEC23B)
Evidence of secondary iron overload without transfusion history
Abnormalities in erythrocyte morphology including anisopoikilocytosis and basophilic stippling

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of chronic hemolytic anemia with characteristic bone marrow dyserythropoiesis and identification of pathogenic mutation in CDA-associated genes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other causes of hemolytic anemia and iron overload.

laboratory: Elevated serum bilirubin and lactate dehydrogenase
Iron overload markers elevated (serum ferritin, transferrin saturation)
imaging: Bone marrow expansion visible on radiographs
genetic: Pathogenic mutations in CDAN1, SEC23B, or other CDA-associated genes
other: Bone marrow biopsy showing multinucleated erythroblasts and dyserythropoiesis

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of spherocytes on peripheral smear
Lack of multinucleated erythroblasts in bone marrow
Severe microcytic anemia with target cells
Different bone marrow morphology without multinucleated erythroblasts

redFlags: Severe anemia refractory to standard treatments
Progressive iron overload without transfusion history
Presence of multinucleated erythroblasts on bone marrow biopsy
